initialization: Seeded shared cell; zero transport/viscosity heads; inherited frozen learned pressure and1000-update flux calibration only
pressure_readout: Complete learned unit-response map on three small geometries; original neural component at32cube
momentum_readout: Negative spatial transpose of the same pretrained neural flux weights
transport: Learned local bilinear/upwind/cubic features, contextual readout, learned linear viscosity branch; no native transport call
tracer: Entering-velocity conditional neural convex weights with global motion gate; first tracer cannot use current/future force; zero entering velocity preserves first tracer exactly
internal_history: Deployment-equivalent physical reconstruction and encoding between each internal step
training: Original16train scenes, normalization, sample stream, increment-MSE objective and10000-update schedule; architecture changes, no single-factor attribution
initial_cold_accuracy: Diagnostic only; not a temporal target claim or selection gate
